Concerns: Not much hands-on with very heavy sharded key-value stores at 1M+ keys (we'd want to validate with references). Some gaps on advanced quantization pipelines — but good conceptual knowledge.

Scores (quick, out of 5): Systems: 4; Scalability: 3; Fit: 4. Overall: should move to reference + a short follow-up on quantization specifics.

Action items: Elena — can you please run two references (former manager + tech lead) and share detailed notes? Asha also said she'd be available next week for a 30-min follow-up deep-dive on quantization (Tue/Wed preferred).
